basic_details.short_information: Panjab University, Chandigarh will fill the posts of Clerks from its in-service Class C employees through a Data Entry Computer Proficiency including Word Processing Test/Typing Test on Computer followed by a Written Test. Only Class C employees of the University who are at least matriculate and have a minimum of 5 years service as on 30 November 2026 may apply. The application form, countersigned by the Chairperson/Head of the Department/Branch, must reach the Establishment Branch office on or before 21 December 2026; no application will be entertained after this date.

content_sections.heading: About Panjab University Clerks
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Assistant Registrar, Establishment Branch, Panjab University, Chandigarh, under amended Rule 3 (d) of P.U. Calendar Volume-III. It is addressed to the Chairpersons/Heads of all teaching and non-teaching departments, offices and branches, the Director, PUSSGRC, Bajwara, Hoshiarpur, the Chairperson, VVBIS & IS, Hoshiarpur, the Director, P.U.R.C., Muktsar Sahib/Ludhiana/Kauni, and the Director, P.U. Ext. Library, Ludhiana, who are asked to bring it to the notice of all Class C employees working under them.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form is printed on page 2 of the notice and is addressed to The Registrar, Panjab University, Chandigarh. The completed form must be countersigned by the Chairperson/Head of the Department/Branch and must reach the office of the Assistant Registrar, Establishment Branch, Panjab University, Chandigarh on or before 21 December 2026. The notice does not mention a postal mode or an email address for sending it. The form asks for these particulars: Name and father's name Date of first appointment in Panjab University and the post held then Present designation/post, department/branch, pay-scale, basic pay as on the closing date of application and date of confirmation Total length of service in Panjab University as on the closing date of application Educational qualification with board/university, year, subject and marks/division Declaration and signature of the candidate, followed by verification and signature of the Chairman/Head of Institution/Branch with stamp

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice is for appointment to the posts of Clerks. The number of posts and the pay are not specified in the notice. Who can apply: in-service Class C employees of Panjab University. Educational qualification: at least matriculate. Service: minimum of 5 years service in the University as on 30.11.2026. Age limit: not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

Total marks: 100 Negative marking: no negative marking Minimum qualifying marks: 50% (with 40% minimum in typing test)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Clerk test 2026?
faq.answer: The countersigned application form must reach the Establishment Branch office on or before 21 December 2026, and no application will be entertained after that date.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the Panjab University Clerk test?
faq.answer: Only in-service Class C employees of Panjab University who are at least matriculate and have a minimum of 5 years service as on 30 November 2026 may apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification for the Panjab University Clerk test?
faq.answer: The candidate must be at least matriculate, along with a minimum of 5 years service in the University as on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the Panjab University Clerk test?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form given on page 2 of the notice, attach attested certificates, get it countersigned by the Chairperson/Head of the Department/Branch, and make sure it reaches the Establishment Branch by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for Panjab University Clerks?
faq.answer: Selection is by a Data Entry Computer Proficiency including Word Processing Test/Typing Test on Computer followed by the Written Test, for a total of 100 marks.

faq.question: Q6. What typing speed is required in the Panjab University Clerk test?
faq.answer: The Typing Skill Test uses a passage of about 300 words in 10 minutes, with a minimum speed of 30 w.p.m in English, carrying 60 marks.

faq.question: Q7. Is there negative marking in the Panjab University Clerk test?
faq.answer: No, the notice states there is no negative marking. The minimum qualifying marks are 50%, with 40% minimum in the typing test.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached to the application form?
faq.answer: Attested copies of certificates of each examination must be attached, and the Matriculation Certificate with date of birth is essential.

faq.question: Q9. Does clearing the test guarantee appointment as Clerk?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that simply submitting an application and clearing the test will not vest any legal right to be appointed as Clerk.
